details: swban help                  #List common commands and descriptions
swban help check/csp        #(Example) Show full help for a command
swban help 1                #List top-level commands (/ marks categories; other paths are executable)
swban help 2                #List commands and categories through level 2; higher numbers are supported
swban help check 2          #List commands and categories two levels below check
swban help check/browser 3  #List commands and categories three levels below check/browser
Site development and builds:
swban base/hugo server -D --disableFastRender -p 5678 --bind localhost  #Start the development server
swban base/hugo --minify --gc --cleanDestinationDir                     #Build production output
swban base/hugo --minify --destination ./preview                        #Build to a specified directory
Tools:
swban base/hugo/ensure            #Prepare Hugo
swban base/go/ensure              #Prepare Go
swban base/git/ensure             #Prepare Git
swban base/gh/ensure              #Prepare gh (GitHub CLI)
swban base/node/ensure            #Prepare Node/npm
swban base/bun/ensure             #Prepare optional Bun
swban base/uv/ensure              #Prepare uv (Python tool manager)
swban base/browser/ensure         #Prepare Playwright/Chromium
swban base/<tool> [arguments...]  #Run bun/node/git/gh/go/hugo/uv
Authorization management:
swban deploy/auth/setup  #Open the unified authorization page
Cloudflare:
swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/setup                    #Open local authorization; sign in, save a Token or inspect environment variables
swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/token/check              #Check the saved or manually added Token
swban deploy/cloudflare/cli auth login                #Authorize cf
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler login                #Authorize Wrangler
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy <build-path> --project-name <name> --branch preview  #Publish a Pages preview; use an absolute build path
Windows generic credential: swban/cloudflare/default; password: API Token; user name: account ID or api-token.
Tencent Cloud tools:
swban deploy/tencent/auth/setup         #Open Tencent Cloud authorization
swban deploy/tencent/auth/key/check     #Check the saved access key
swban deploy/tencent/cli --version       #Run tccli; prepare dependencies as needed
swban deploy/tencent/cli/ensure          #Prepare the pinned tccli version
swban deploy/tencent/cli/check           #Check the local tccli installation
swban deploy/tencent/cli auth login      #Authorize tccli in the browser
swban deploy/tencent/cli teo help        #Show EdgeOne commands
Checks:
swban doctor [directory]        #Check tools and the site theme
swban check/delivery [dir]      #Check assets/site/delivery.toml and its rendered output
swban check/csp [dir]           #Check CSP and inline hashes
swban check/browser/site [dir]  #Run browser checks
swban report/size/html [dir]    #Report page size and size on first load
swban sync/ext [id...]          #Sync declared external resources
Before a theme upgrade, check these four items in the official repository:
swban help upgrade/git  #Run this command for detailed help before upgrading
hugo.toml               #1 Site configuration
content/                #2 Lists, article/product examples and functional pages
assets/                 #3 Site resources and interface dictionaries
archetypes/             #4 Content templates
Theme developers:
Tags use SemVer; project and Module tags must have the same version and commit.
swban deploy/release/tag --check                               #Validate versions and preview tags first
swban deploy/release/tag                                       #Publish both tags atomically after checks pass
swban base/gh auth login --web                                 #Sign in to GitHub
swban base/gh release create <tag> --verify-tag --notes <URL>  #Link release notes
swban help                  #列出常用命令和说明
swban help check/csp        #(示例)查看具体命令说明
swban help 1                #列出所有一级命令（含/结尾的是分类，否则为可执行，下同）
swban help 2                #列出所有一至二级命令和分类,数字可以大于2
swban help check 2          #列出 check 下两层命令和分类
swban help check/browser 3  #列出 check/browser 下三层命令和分类
站点开发与构建：
swban base/hugo server -D --disableFastRender -p 5678 --bind localhost  #启动开发服
swban base/hugo --minify --gc --cleanDestinationDir                     #生产构建
swban base/hugo --minify --destination ./preview                        #构建到指定目录
工具：
swban base/hugo/ensure     #准备 Hugo
swban base/go/ensure       #准备 Go
swban base/git/ensure      #准备 Git
swban base/gh/ensure       #准备 gh (GitHub CLI)
swban base/node/ensure     #准备 Node/npm
swban base/bun/ensure      #准备可选 Bun
swban base/uv/ensure       #准备 uv（Python 工具管理器）
swban base/browser/ensure  #准备 Playwright/Chromium
swban base/<tool> [参数...]  #运行 bun/node/git/gh/go/hugo/uv
授权管理：
swban deploy/auth/setup  #打开统一授权页
Cloudflare：
swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/setup                    #打开本机授权页，登录、保存 Token 或查看环境变量
swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/token/check              #检查网页保存或手工添加的 Token
swban deploy/cloudflare/cli auth login                #登录并授权 cf
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler login                #登录并授权 Wrangler
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy <build-path> --project-name <name> --branch preview  #发布 Pages 预览；构建路径用绝对路径
Windows 普通凭据：swban/cloudflare/default；密码填 API Token；用户名填账号 ID 或 api-token。
腾讯云工具：
swban deploy/tencent/auth/setup         #打开腾讯云授权页
swban deploy/tencent/auth/key/check     #检查已保存的访问密钥
swban deploy/tencent/cli --version       #运行 tccli，按需准备依赖
swban deploy/tencent/cli/ensure          #准备固定版本的 tccli
swban deploy/tencent/cli/check           #检查本地 tccli 安装
swban deploy/tencent/cli auth login      #通过浏览器授权 tccli
swban deploy/tencent/cli teo help        #查看 EdgeOne 命令
检测：
swban doctor [目录]            #检查工具和站点主题
swban check/delivery [dir]     #检查 assets/site/delivery.toml 及其渲染产物
swban check/csp [dir]          #检查 CSP 与内联哈希
swban check/browser/site [dir] #执行浏览器检查
swban report/size/html [dir]   #统计页面与首次加载体积
swban sync/ext [id...]         #同步已声明的外部资源
主题升级，先检查官方仓库以下四项的变动：
swban help upgrade/git  #具体升级时，务必执行此命令查看详细帮助
hugo.toml               #1 站点配置
content/                #2 列表、文章/产品示例与功能页
assets/                 #3 站点资源与界面字典
archetypes/             #4 内容模板
主题开发者：
标签采用语义版本；项目与 Module 标签的版本号和提交须一致。
swban deploy/release/tag --check                               #先校验版本并预览标签
swban deploy/release/tag                                       #校验通过后，原子发布两个标签
swban base/gh auth login --web                                 #登录 GitHub
swban base/gh release create <tag> --verify-tag --notes <URL>  #链接版本记录
